columns.defaultConstraints: REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

dialectAwareDefaultConstraints.sqlite: REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

data.name: completions_view
data.sql: CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "completions_view" ("id", "profile_id", "curriculum_id", "sefaria_ref", "stage_id", "track_type", "track_id", "points", "event_timestamp", "stage_id_format") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."profile_id" AS "profile_id", "t0"."curriculum_id" AS "curriculum_id", "t0"."sefaria_ref" AS "sefaria_ref", "t0"."stage_id" AS "stage_id", "t0"."track_type" AS "track_type", "t0"."track_id" AS "track_id", "t0"."points" AS "points", "t0"."event_timestamp" AS "event_timestamp", "t0"."stage_id_format" AS "stage_id_format" FROM "completion_events" "t0"

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "email" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "firebase_uid" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "password_hash" TEXT NULL, "tier" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learner_profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mode IN ('adult', 'child')), "avatar_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_tutored" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_tutored" IN (0, 1)), "tutor_parent_uid" TEXT NULL, "tutor_remote_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "tutor_grant_id" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_tracks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', "state_changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "activated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pace_reset_date" INTEGER NULL, "last_reorder_at" INTEGER NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "curriculum_scopes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id), "scope_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scope_value" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "scope_level", "scope_value", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profile_programs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "curriculum_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "program_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tracking_start_date" INTEGER NULL, "tracking_start_ref" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_type"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stage_definitions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id), "stage_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "schedule" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"type":"delay","delay_days":0}', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "stage_order", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "point_configs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id), "stage_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "points" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (points > 0), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "stage_order", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "study_day_configs" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id), "day_of_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "day_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'study', "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "day_of_week", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "completion_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NULL, "points" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "event_timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "purged_at" INTEGER NULL, "stage_id_format" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plan_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stage_definition_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_overdue" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_overdue" IN (0, 1)), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "stage_name" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "estimated_effort_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "plan_date", "sefaria_ref", "stage_order", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_ledger" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ulid" TEXT NOT NULL, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_identifier" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_display_name_he" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_display_name_en" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completion_number" INTEGER NOT NULL, "marked_by" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_manual" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_manual" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bookmarks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "track_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "learning_order" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "learning_order_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "curriculum_id", "sefaria_ref"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "track_learning_order" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("profile_id", "track_id", "sefaria_ref"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "track_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES curriculum_tracks (id), "target_percent" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 100.0, "target_date" INTEGER NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "date_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gregorian', "goal_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'deadline', "pace_value" INTEGER NULL, "pace_period" TEXT NULL, "pace_granularity" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "streak_events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "day_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "event_timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL, "client_device_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "text_download_statuses" ("curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "text_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "downloaded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stored_item_count" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("curriculum_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sacred_window_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "start_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "lat" REAL NULL, "lng" REAL NULL, "in_israel" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("in_israel" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "prior_completion_imports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "curriculum_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sefaria_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "stage_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "track_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_kv" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "synced_at_ms" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "entity_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "points_balance" ("profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "balance" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reward_redemptions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "reward_title" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon_index" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "points_cost" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_fulfilment', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ulid" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "points_ledger" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "profile_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES learner_profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entry_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "redemption_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES reward_redemptions (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ulid" TEXT NULL, "sync_enqueued_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS "completions_view" ("id", "profile_id", "curriculum_id", "sefaria_ref", "stage_id", "track_type", "track_id", "points", "event_timestamp", "stage_id_format") AS SELECT "t0"."id" AS "id", "t0"."profile_id" AS "profile_id", "t0"."curriculum_id" AS "curriculum_id", "t0"."sefaria_ref" AS "sefaria_ref", "t0"."stage_id" AS "stage_id", "t0"."track_type" AS "track_type", "t0"."track_id" AS "track_id", "t0"."points" AS "points", "t0"."event_timestamp" AS "event_timestamp", "t0"."stage_id_format" AS "stage_id_format" FROM "completion_events" "t0"
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX completion_events_natural_key ON completion_events (profile_id, sefaria_ref, stage_id, track_type, curriculum_id)
CREATE INDEX learning_ledger_profile_created ON learning_ledger (profile_id, created_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX learning_ledger_profile_ulid ON learning_ledger (profile_id, ulid)
CREATE INDEX goals_profile_curriculum ON goals (profile_id, curriculum_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX streak_events_natural_key ON streak_events (profile_id, day_utc, event_type)
CREATE INDEX outbox_profile_kind ON outbox (profile_id, entity_kind)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX points_ledger_profile_ulid ON points_ledger (profile_id, ulid)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX reward_redemptions_profile_ulid ON reward_redemptions (profile_id, ulid)
